input: Check the crawl space for moisture damage

gold.taskTitle: Inspect Crawl Space for Moisture Damage
gold.taskDescription: Check the crawl space thoroughly to identify any signs of moisture damage, water intrusion, or related issues.

questions.title: Have you ever inspected this crawl space before?
questions.description: Understanding prior inspection history helps gauge what baseline knowledge exists about the space.

questions.title: What specific signs of damage are you already seeing?
questions.description: Knowing whether there are visible clues like staining, odor, or pooling water focuses the inspection.

questions.title: What is the approximate size of the crawl space?
questions.description: The square footage or dimensions affect how long the inspection will take and what tools are needed.

questions.title: Does the crawl space have a vapor barrier installed?
questions.description: The presence or absence of a vapor barrier changes what to look for and how moisture behaves in the space.

questions.title: Are you doing this inspection yourself or hiring someone?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan should focus on DIY preparation or finding a professional inspector.

questions.title: What tools or equipment do you currently have available?
questions.description: Knowing available tools such as a flashlight, moisture meter, or protective gear shapes the action steps.

questions.title: Is there a deadline driving this inspection, like a home sale?
questions.description: A time constraint such as a real estate closing or insurance claim affects the urgency and sequencing of tasks.
